title: How vibe coding is changing music gear and production
excerpt: Musicians are utilizing vibe coding powered by artificial intelligence to customize their equipment and alter their sound.
body_html:
Artificial intelligence continues to impact various industries, including the music sector. A new development known as vibe coding is currently changing the ways musicians approach the creation of music.

Artists are adopting this method to modify their sound and customize their gear. By leveraging these AI-driven processes, creators are finding new methods to alter how their music is made and how equipment functions.
